The name Mehrsa carries the meaning “Bountiful, Generous” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Persian, Arabic. Parents who choose Mehrsa usually hope their child will grow to embody bountiful, generous and live with faith, good character and purpose.
